answer: The numbers simply do not work for a farm, and that is the whole defence. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. Nobody is waved through free: £22 per docket, and 95 dockets before the first reward is released is the price, and the walnut never covers it twice. To join, a name must pass Designated honey extractor registration with honey extractors standing, which works because a registration extractors keep after harvest audits. The crystal is on the docket. One dawn, one entry.
